title: Bare pulsing dot marks a live row
description: Strip the word entirely: a single pulsing green dot immediately before the countdown marks a live-estimated row, like a recording light. The most signage-like, lowest-ink option. A bare dot is ambiguous on its own — only viable paired with a legend or an occasional labelled state.
baseline_ref: app/components/ArrivalRow.vue: estimated rows use the 'estimado' pill + scheduled prefix

changes.intent: Prefix the countdown with a lone live dot for estimated rows, dropping the pill and prefix.
changes.detail: Remove the .arrival-row__badge--estimated pill and the .arrival-row__scheduled span. When arrival.estimated && etaMinutes > 0, render a leading before the number inside .arrival-row__eta.

changes.intent: Pulsing live dot, vertically centred against the large countdown.
Provide the key the bare dot depends on; render only when a row is estimated.
changes.detail: When arrivals.some(a => a.estimated), render a muted legend under the list: a green dot + 'Salida estimada en tiempo real'.
